chats.answer:
If you're looking for a 3D printer with a fully enclosed chamber, I'd recommend considering models from Bambu Lab, Creality, QIDI, and Flashforge.

An enclosed 3D printer offers several advantages:

Better temperature stability for printing ABS, ASA, nylon, and other engineering materials.

Less warping on larger prints.

Reduced noise and some containment of dust and fumes (though ventilation is still important).

Better protection from drafts, pets, and accidental contact.

Here are some good options across different budgets.
